title: PR #36990 added the support app's CourseTeamManageAPIView with only IsAuthenticated, without the support-role gate every sibling support view uses, so any learner can probe arbitrary accounts and instructors can read other users' course roles.

findings.explanation: The diff contains only Python code using Django ORM and DRF serializers. There are no raw SQL queries, string concatenations into SQL, or direct database access methods that would allow SQL injection.

The diff includes tests for a 'CourseTeamManageAPIView' that handles role assignment (PUT) and retrieval (GET). The tests verify that instructors can only see their courses and that admins can manage roles. However, the actual implementation of the view (the code that performs the authorization checks and role assignments) is not present in the diff. Without seeing the view code, it is impossible to confirm if proper ownership checks (CWE-639) or role-based access controls (CWE-862) are correctly implemented. The tests suggest the intended behavior, but the implementation is missing.
findings.suggested_fix: Review the implementation of 'CourseTeamManageAPIView' to ensure that: 1) GET requests filter courses based on the requesting user's role (e.g., instructor vs admin). 2) PUT requests verify that the requesting user has the necessary permissions to assign/revoke roles for the specified course and target user. 3) Ensure that user IDs/emails are validated and that the target user exists before performing operations.
